# Contributing

When contributing to this repository, please first discuss the change you
wish to make via issue before making a change, especially for anything
beyond a small fix.

Please note this project has a [code of conduct][coc], please follow it in
all your interactions with the project.

## Issues and feature requests

Found a bug in the source code, a mistake in the documentation, or have a
feature you'd like to see? You can help by submitting an issue to this
[GitHub repository][github]. Before opening a new one, please search
existing issues first - your question or bug may already be covered.

Even better: feel free to submit a pull request with a fix or new feature!

## Pull request process

1. Search this repository for open or closed [pull requests][prs] related
   to your change first, so effort isn't duplicated.
2. Since this is a personal fork maintained by a single person, pull
   requests are reviewed and merged directly by the maintainer rather than
   requiring sign-off from multiple developers.
3. Automated dependency updates (via Renovate) are reviewed the same way -
   most patch/minor updates automerge once CI passes; anything else is
   reviewed manually.

[coc]: CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md
[github]: https://github.com/Alfie51m/addon-vscode/issues
[prs]: https://github.com/Alfie51m/addon-vscode/pulls
